items.title: Show HN: Learn to program a modular synthesizer in the browser
items.summary: I’m a software engineer and always wanted a simpler way to play around with modular synthesizers, without having to spend thousands of $. So I built Ostra: a modular synth that runs entirely in the browser, with dozens of modules and a short interactive tutorial. There's no need to install anything, or even log in. Everything runs in the browser and you can even record your patches and save .WAVs to your disk. I’d be interested in feedback on the implementation, UX, and what other programmable modules would be worth adding. Thanks for checking this out!

items.summary: Using a good deal of Claude, I got OrcaSlicer (and preFlight slicer) engines running in client-side WebAssembly with a full feature set for painting, slicing, assembling, and printing 3d models. It also supports a minimal level of TinkerCAD-style CSG modeling, as well as importing models from https://cubbycad.com I've been using it extensively when I need to trigger prints at home from my work computer.
